result.instructions: Tools for Zaui, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which activities run on 2026-12-01, and how many places are left?"; "Show the day manifest for 2026-12-01: who is booked on each activity."; "Find booking 40234 and show its status and balance.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zaui data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zaui_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zaui_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zaui_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zaui_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zaui_list_activity_catalog
tools.title: List activity and product catalog
tools.description: List the activities and products of this Zaui system, grouped by category, with their IDs. Start here to find an activityId or productId. ZAPI: zapiGetActivityAndProductCatalog.

tools.name: zaui_list_activities_by_date
tools.title: List activities by date
tools.description: List every activity that runs on one date, with its category and availability. ZAPI: zapiGetAllActivitiesByDate.

tools.name: zaui_get_activity_details
tools.title: Get activity details
tools.description: Get one activity's details for a date: its times, duration, prices and inventory fields. ZAPI: zapiGetActivityDetailsByActivityId.

activityId.description: The activity ID from the catalog.

verboseMode.description: true for the full detail; false (default) for a shorter reply.

tools.name: zaui_check_activity_inventory
tools.title: Check activity inventory
tools.description: Check the free places of an activity on a date, for each activity time, with a readable status (AVAILABLE, FREESALE, SOLD OUT). ZAPI: zapiCheckActivityInventoryByDate.

activityId.description: The activity ID from the catalog.

activityDate.description: The travel date, yyyy-mm-dd. Empty means today.

activityTime.description: One start time, hh:mm:ss. Empty means every configured time.

tools.name: zaui_check_product_inventory
tools.title: Check product inventory
tools.description: Check the stock of one product, optionally for a quantity. ZAPI: zapiCheckProductInventory.

productId.description: The product ID from the catalog.

quantity.description: How many items to check for. Empty returns the total inventory.

tools.name: zaui_search_bookings
tools.title: Search bookings
tools.description: Search bookings by guest name (101), mobile number (102), booking ID (103) or voucher number (104). Returns guest contact details, so use it only for the customer's own bookings. ZAPI: zapiSearchBookings.

searchType.description: 101 guest name, 102 mobile number, 103 booking ID, 104 voucher number.

searchText.description: The value to search for, for the chosen searchType.

verboseMode.description: true for the full booking detail.

tools.name: zaui_get_booking
tools.title: Get booking by number
tools.description: Get one booking by its confirmation number: the guest, the activities, the balance and the status. Returns guest contact details. ZAPI: zapiSearchBookingsByBookingNumber.

bookingNumber.description: The confirmation number of the booking.

tools.name: zaui_get_day_manifest
tools.title: Get day manifest
tools.description: List every booking for every activity on one date (the day's manifest), with guest counts and guides. Returns guest names. ZAPI: zapiGetManifestEntireDayByDate.

tools.name: zaui_get_activity_manifest
tools.title: Get activity manifest
tools.description: List the bookings of one activity on one date (the activity's manifest), optionally for one start time. Returns guest names. ZAPI: zapiGetManifestIndividualByActivityIdAndDate.

activityId.description: The activity ID from the catalog.

activityTime.description: One start time, hh:mm:ss. Empty means every time.
